note: Scripted dictation sessions for the context benchmark. Invented people, projects and places; nothing here comes from anyone's real log. Each session interleaves two threads. Probes mishear a name that an earlier take said correctly: a near probe's name was said within the last eight takes, which the recent-dictations examples can carry; a far probe's name was not, so only context can recover it. Controls must come back unchanged in meaning and language.

persona.personalContext:
PERSONAL
A machine-learning researcher who also builds small apps. Dictates in English, and in Korean when chatting with family. Keep the speaker's wording, formality and language; fix grammar and punctuation. Never translate.

EXCEPTIONS
Apply only the notes that match <target-app>. Ignore the rest.
- Terminal: if a command was dictated, keep it as a command.
- Slack / Messages / KakaoTalk: keep casual.
